claim.claim: Our classifier achieves 92% accuracy and generalizes to new centres.
claim.split_desc: Records were randomly divided into 75% training and 25% test with a fixed random seed.
claim.methods_line: Records were randomly divided into 75% training and 25% test with a fixed random seed.

hypotheses.text: Accuracy is inflated by site leakage: site identifier c_8d423f remains in features and same sites appear on both sides of random split, so model learns site->label shortcut that fails on unseen centres.
hypotheses.predicted_signature: Grouped-by-site split accuracy drops substantially (>10pp from 92% toward site-prior/majority baseline) while random split stays ~92% with same features and seed.

hypotheses.text: Model learns site-invariant biology and truly generalizes to new centres; random-split estimate is unbiased.
hypotheses.predicted_signature: Grouped-by-site accuracy matches claimed ~92% within sampling noise (+/- few pp, overlapping CIs).

hypotheses.text: Drop under grouped split is due to site-specific label prevalence / covariate shift, not site-ID shortcut; model is calibrated within-site but prior changes.
hypotheses.predicted_signature: Grouped accuracy drops but per-site balanced accuracy / AUC holds and error tracks site prevalence difference; dropping SITE feature alone does not recover grouped performance.

hyp.broken_assumption: Random record-level split is i.i.d. and estimates new-centre performance; i.e., no site-level clustering/leakage and SITE feature does not provide a non-generalizing shortcut.
hyp.code_patch:
import train
def controlled_eval(df, seed):
    tr, te = train.split_idx(df, seed, groups=df[train.SITE])
    f = train.feats(df)
    y_true = df[train.TARGET].to_numpy()[te]
    y_pred = train.fit_predict(df[f].to_numpy()[tr], df[train.TARGET].to_numpy()[tr], df[f].to_numpy()[te], seed)
    return (y_true, y_pred)
